properties.name: `coverage` and `confirm` move behind `ifc:graph-read`, taking the count from one module to three. Both were selected by MEASUREMENT rather than guess: of the 17 read-only modules, only these two make zero calls outside the contract's five operations. `confirm` is the first to exercise FOUR of the five (scan_nodes, get_node, outgoing, incoming), so it is the first real test that the contract is wide enough to stand a module on rather than merely wide enough for the easy case. Both keep a one-line inherent method, so no caller changed. Also corrected an earlier suggestion: `report` is NOT cheap — it needs 26 other DesignGraph methods.
